jobs_results.title: QA Engineer - 2476
jobs_results.description:
Why YOU want this position
Enverus has expanded its solutions in Power & Renewables with the addition of RatedPower. A high growth start up, RatedPower’s technology expands our portfolio of solutions in solar with its cloud-based software that automates and optimizes the feasibility study, analysis, design and engineering of solar power plants, and our geographical coverage internationally.

Enverus is the leading energy SaaS company delivering highly technical insights and predictive/prescriptive analytics that empower customers to make decisions that increase profit. Enverus’ innovative technologies drive production and investment strategies, enable best practices for energy and commodity trading and risk management, and reduce costs through automated processes across critical business functions. Enverus is a strategic partner to more than 6,000 customers in 50 countries.

We are currently seeking a QA Engineer to join our RatedPower team working in Madrid or remote. This role... offers the opportunity to join a rapidly growing company delivering industry-leading solutions. Be a part of the energy transition and join our growing team, creating intelligent connections across the energy value chain with a strategic focus on growing our offerings in Power & Renewables.
What you’ll do:
• Assist and collaborate with Product Management, Design, and Engineering to define test plans, test cases, and acceptance criteria.
• Work closely within the Front and Backend Development Teams.
• Help test the application through both manual and automated means by following the testing pyramid.
• Contribute to improving and applying QA best practices, provide specific guidance to developers.
• Help maintain documentation.
• Report and assist in triage of issues related to the product.
• Understand the business and use this understanding to influence their task prioritisation.
What you should have:
• 2+ years of relevant experience.
• Solid understanding of the software development lifecycle.
• Experience of working in an agile software development environment.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
• Excellent verbal and written communication.
• Familiar with any of the following programming languages: Java, Javascript.
• Experience in both manual and automated testing: unit, integration, end-to-end.
• Experience in automation tools such as Cypress.
• Comfortable with version control systems.
Valuable skills:
• Experience of software development.
• Continuous integration and issue tracking tools such JIRA.
• Knowledge of Civil or Electrical Engineering.

What we offer:
• Work on a unique product where you can see the result of your work materialize in every new release.
• You choose: position fully remote (based in Spain) or hybrid working model (able to combine working from home and from our office in Madrid city center).
• Career development according to your aspirations and interests. We support our employees with continuous training.
• Health insurance, meals/transportation and other benefits.
• The opportunity to challenge in a high-performing organization and leave each day knowing you have made an impact

jobs_results.description:

We are Semrush, a global IT company developing our own product – a platform for digital marketers. New stars are born here, so don’t miss your chance.

This is our Quality Assurance Engineer role for those who want to turn ideas into reality and participate in improving Semrush’s analytics tools.

Tasks in the role
• Orchestrate testing activities in the Analytics Team together with another QA engineer. Up to 30 individual stakeholders.
• Analytics testing srategy development, depending on seniority and skills: minimum – participation, maximum – re-creation and re-implementation.
• Manual testing – full cycle.
• Automated testing – full cycle, on top of manual testing.

jobs_results.description:
08/6/2023
- SW Development
- Tester/QA

Junior QA Tester - Madrid

Madrid

Inicio de sesión
• *Organización**:
• *Función**:
Nuestro cliente es un grupo internacional especializado en la prestación de servicios convergentes e integrales de telecomunicaciones, cloud, conectividad y seguridad para empresas.

Desarrollan soluciones con el objetivo de ayudar a los diferentes clientes a adptar y optimizar la tecnología cloud aportando:

- Soluciones telco-cloud potentes, seguras e innovadoras
- Actualizaciones disponibles con posterioridad a la contratación
- Servicio técnico y comercial 24/7
• *Requisitos**:

- Carrera universitaria o grado en Ciencias de la Computación, Ingeniería de Software, Ingeniería Informática u otros campos relacionados.
- Español hablado y escrito e Inglés lectura
- Experiência igual o superior a 1 año.
• *Oferta**:
El objetivo principal es garantizar que las aplicaciones cumplan con los estándares de calidad establecidos, identificar y reportar errores o... defectos, y colaborar en la mejora continua del proceso de desarrollo.
• *Información**:

- Realizar pruebas manuales en aplicaciones web para verificar su funcionamiento
- Ejecutar y mantener los planes de pruebas existentes, siguiendo los procedimientos establecidos
- Identificar, registrar y reportar de manera precisa los errores o defectos encontrados durante las pruebas
- Colaborar con el equipo de desarrollo para comprender los requisitos y las funcionalidades de las aplicaciones
- Participar en reuniones de seguimiento y revisión del progreso del proyecto
- Cuando sea necesario, desarrollar y mantener pruebas automatizadas utilizando la librería Selenium en Python.
- Cuando sea necesario, contribuir a la mejora continua de los procesos de pruebas y desarrollo de software.
• *Postulación**:
Somos People first, esa es nuestra cultura. Fundamentamos nuestra misión en mejorar la vida de las personas creando un entorno en el que puedan convertirse en la mejor versión de sí mismas y ejerciendo un liderazgo por valores.

En Claire Joster formamos parte de Eurofirms Group, primera empresa española de RR. HH. con capital nacional, con más de 1.000 empleados y 130 oficinas. Tenemos presencia en España, Portugal, Italia, Holanda y Chile, y contamos con partners locales en todo el mundo. Con una facturación de 351M€, somos una de las empresas europeas con mayor crecimiento según el ranking de The Financial Times

jobs_results.title: Quality Tester with French
jobs_results.description:
We are looking for a self-starting, proactive problem solver to join our Quality Assurance team!

As part of this team, you will start working in a very exciting project with for one of the key players in the technology industry worldwide in testing activities as part of a project, which involves artificial intelligence and wearables.

What would be your main responsibilities?

· Analysis of the requirements, develop and execute tests

· Report test findings and document new errors.

· Provide or validate estimates for assigned tasks

· Contribute towards test automation in a gradual manner

What would be the requirements for this role?

· Be a native speaker French from France or Switzerland or living in the country of the language for the last years (mandatory).

· Country-related cultural awareness (pop, formal, geo-political…).

· Minimum 2 years’ experience of software testing or quality engineering work

· Good knowledge of awareness of testing processes like defect management... test design creation etc.

· Experience on scripting.

· Experience with tools like ALM, Jira, and Jenkins.

· At least 6+ months of automation testing experience

· Ideally, knowledge of programming languages like Java or Python.

· Ability to analyse test results and identify patterns of issues, troubleshoot scenarios and compile detailed reports

· Knowledge or experience with new Technology adoption like devices, virtual assistants and gadgets

What do we offer?

· Long term opportunity to grow in one of the most successful technology consultancy companies all over the world.

· Innovative project related with artificial intelligence, wearables and virtual assistants.
